turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Judy Gomez, mrn 869723. Date of birth, 5, 7, 1961. She's in office today for ongoing management of psoriatic arthritis. Hello, Judy, how are you doing today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I'm doing good, thank you. How are you?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I'm great, thanks. So how have you been since the last time? I know the last time we were talking about decreasing your prednisone dose, correct?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes. I'm just on one now and that seems to be enough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Aw, that's great to hear.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, there were a couple days there I took an extra one, just because there was a little extra pain in my feet. And I do have a desk job, so when I have a day off where I'm moving around a lot they do tend to hurt a bit more.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. How many times did you do that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, it wasn't often, maybe once a week.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. So it sounds like we're still on track for discontinuing the prednisone. We'll do that today and you can let me know how it goes on your next visit. And how about the methotrexate, do you think that helped with your joint pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, definitely. Because I went to get my covid shots, um, but from the letter I got about it, it said that it could interfere with the vaccine, you know, reduce the efficacy. So I didn't take it on the week that I got the first shot.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. And what happened?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I felt absolutely horrible until I took it again a week later.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. And- and what did you do about the second dose?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Well, I called into the hotline because I was in so much pain with the first one. And they said, " no, just go ahead and take it, " so I did.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. That's good then. We do have to keep an eye out on it since it's a high-risk medication. Do you have an appointment to get your blood drawn for the next time?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, they didn't give me one.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. So we can do that for you too. Uhm, so what questions do you have for me, Judy?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Well, I just wanted to know why I was getting all these bruises here, so like when I bump myself. I don't know where they're coming from.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. That's probably from the prednisone, it can increase bruising.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay. I didn't know that. Um, I don't even feel it when it happens, they just show up.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah. Unfortunately that can happen, but we're working on discontinuing that so let's see if the bruises do go away.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay. That sounds good, thanks.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, Judy, please, um, sit up here and I'll take a look. Shoes and socks off please.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: All right.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: All right. Let me see here. Okay. So where is it hurting? In your joints right here?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, a little. Also in my feet joints as well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. And how about when you bend the knee like this?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Well, it hurt before we increased the methotrexate, but it's doing pretty good now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, good. Can you flex your toes please? Good range of motion. Also ridges in nails, that's from the psoriasis.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah. They've been like that for a long time now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. All right, uhm, ms Gomez, it looks like we're moving along with your treatment nicely. We'll stop your prednisone and continue with the methotrexate. Make sure to stop by the front desk and make an appointment for the blood work, and I'll see you in three months.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: All right. It sounds good. Thank you so much, it was great to see you.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: It was great seeing you too. Thank you.
